# PR & commit conventions

This repo enforces Conventional Commits via amannn/action-semantic-pull-request.

When generating PR titles or commit messages:
- Format: `<type>: <subject>` (e.g. `feat: add login flow`)
- Allowed types: feat, fix, chore, docs, refactor, test, perf, ci, build, style, revert
- The subject MUST start with a lowercase letter
- No trailing period
- Imperative mood ("add" not "added"/"adds")
